dogecoin.text: Memecoins like Dogecoin and Shiba Inu didn’t succeed because a celebrity backed them. They succeeded because they built a cult-like following—a legion of believers who defended their meme with the same dedication that soldiers defend their homeland. https://t.co/exi66z9R72

How to create the next Dogecoin:

1. Deploy another Dogecoin
2. Convince enough people that it is the next Dogecoin 
3. Viola!! You have the next Dogecoin

Crypto is first and most importantly the game of mindset.

Invest in projects with delusional investors AKA Conviction
